content.text: In Zimbabwe, where currency instability and payment restrictions are the norm, digital creators face a critical challenge: how to sell their products globally without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal. These platforms, while powerful, often exclude regions like yours, leaving creators stranded. This is where sovereign commerce infrastructure becomes essential. By building your own crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you gain control over your payment and delivery systems, ensuring that no platform can shut you down. This guide walks you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-what-nobody|Deploying a]]-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-solana-payments-digital-products-guide-leaves-3|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-8|deploying]] the Edge Commerce Stack, a complete solution designed for creators in your position. You’ll learn how to set up a store that accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies, delivers products instantly, and operates entirely on infrastructure you own. No subscriptions, no middlemen, just a system built to withstand the pressures you face daily.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The Edge Commerce Stack is engineered to solve the specific problems digital creators in Zimbabwe encounter. Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable or unreliable due to financial sanctions and currency volatility. This stack bypasses these issues by leveraging Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Each component is chosen for its reliability and cost-efficiency. Cloudflare Pages ensures your store is fast and globally accessible, while Cloudflare Workers handle backend tasks without servers. Supabase provides a scalable database for orders, and NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a minimal 0.5% fee. Together, these tools form a sovereign system that operates independently of any single platform. You own the code, the data, and the process—no one can shut you down or restrict your access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, gather the following: a Cloudflare account (free), a NOWPayments account (no KYC required), and your digital products ready for sale. You’ll also need a domain name, though Cloudflare’s free subdomain works if you’re starting. Familiarize yourself with the basics of GitHub and cloudflare.com, as these platforms host your store and backend. If you’re new to crypto, set up a wallet on a low-fee network like BSC, Solana, or TRON to receive payments. Finally, ensure your products are formatted for instant delivery—zipped files, direct download links, or access keys. The Edge Commerce Stack includes templates for product pages, so you don’t need to design from scratch. With these elements in place, you’re ready to deploy.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Create an API key in your NOWPayments dashboard and integrate it with Cloudflare Workers using the provided webhook template. This ensures payments are verified on-chain instantly, triggering product delivery automatically. Next, set up your delivery system. Upload your products to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, then configure Cloudflare Workers to generate secure, time-limited download links upon payment confirmation. For order tracking, connect Supabase to store transaction details. The Edge Commerce Stack includes pre-built scripts for these integrations, so you’re not starting from zero. Test each component locally before deploying to ensure everything works as expected. This step is critical—a broken payment or delivery pipeline means lost sales and frustrated customers.
Own your infrastructure—no platform can shut you down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages by connecting your GitHub repository. Once live, test the entire flow on the mainnet: place an order using a small crypto amount, verify payment confirmation, and ensure the product is delivered correctly. Monitor the Supabase dashboard to confirm the order is logged. If everything works, promote your store to your audience. Share the link on social media, email lists, or forums. For your first customers, offer a discount or bonus product to build trust. Remember, this infrastructure is designed to handle transactions without your intervention, but always monitor for anomalies. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day support, so reach out if you encounter issues during this phase.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is live and processing transactions, focus on scaling. Add more products to your catalog using the included templates—the stack supports up to five products out of the box, but you can expand by duplicating existing configurations. Optimize your store’s performance by enabling Cloudflare’s CDN and caching features. As your customer base grows, consider upgrading to a paid Supabase plan for higher database limits. For marketing, integrate email capture using Google Sheets or a third-party service like Mailchimp. The Edge Commerce Stack’s modular design allows you to add features without rebuilding from scratch. Your goal is to maximize revenue while maintaining the sovereignty of your infrastructure. With this stack, you’re not just selling products—you’re building a resilient business that operates on your terms.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The Edge Commerce Stack is a complete digital commerce solution designed for creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable. It combines Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This stack ensures you own your infrastructure, accept 300+ cryptocurrencies, and deliver products instantly. Deployed in 48 hours, it includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, end-to-end testing, and 30-day support. Priced at $197, it’s a one-time investment for lifetime access to a system that works even in financially isolated regions.
Accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC required.

For $197, you get a fully deployed store on Cloudflare Pages, integrated with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, and configured for instant product delivery. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more and start building a store that no platform can shut down.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a Cloudflare account and set up Cloudflare Pages for hosting.
2. Sign up for NOWPayments and generate an API key for crypto transactions.
3. Prepare your digital products and upload them to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive.
4. Configure Cloudflare Workers to handle payment verification and product delivery.
5. Connect Supabase to store order details and track transactions.
6. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages and test the entire flow on the mainnet.
7. Promote your store to your audience and monitor performance.
8. Scale by adding more products and optimizing your infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m new to crypto?

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack is designed for creators at all levels of crypto experience. NOWPayments handles the complexity of crypto transactions, and the stack includes guides for setting up wallets on low-fee networks like BSC or Solana.
What happens if a payment fails?

The system automatically retries payment verification. If it fails repeatedly, the order is marked as incomplete in Supabase, and no product is delivered. Customers can retry payment using a different cryptocurrency or network.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No, the Edge Commerce Stack is a one-time purchase. You own the infrastructure after deployment. The only ongoing cost is the 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments for crypto transactions.
Can I customize the store’s design?
Yes, the stack includes templates for product pages, which you can customize using HTML and CSS. Cloudflare Pages supports static site generators like Jekyll or Hugo for more advanced designs.
What support is included?

The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day email support for deployment and troubleshooting. For ongoing assistance, you can purchase additional support packages or consult the documentation provided with the stack.
